resources.string: Leave blank to keep the saved credential
Credentials were restored for %1$d provider(s). API keys from the backup replace the keys on this device. Accounts signed in here are kept unless their sign-in has expired.

Restore merges the backup into this device. Matching providers, model settings and groups use the backup values, including API keys. Groups with the same name are combined. Device-only items and accounts whose sign-in has not expired are kept.
